title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Advantages of Remote Work for Employees and Employers
prompt: In many countries, remote work has become a common arrangement for office-based employees. Some people argue that this shift brings significant advantages for both workers and employers. To what extent do you agree that the advantages of remote work outweigh any disadvantages for employees and employers? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类写作任务2的模拟练习。请针对远程办公对雇员和雇主的利弊表明立场，并展开论证。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。建议先用2分钟审题并列出立场与主要论点，再用35分钟左右写作，最后用3-5分钟检查。注意：必须明确回答“在多大程度上同意”并覆盖雇员和雇主两个角度；字数不少于250词；避免背诵模板，用具体理由和例子支持观点。
